headline: Bank of Korea Keeps Policy Rate Unchanged While Signaling Future Tightening
summary: The Bank of Korea left its benchmark interest rate unchanged, though an upbeat economic assessment indicated potential future rate increases following preliminary September producer price index data.
why: The Bank of Korea sets monetary policy for Asia's fourth-largest economy, balancing inflation management with household debt risks and won stability.

impacts.name: South Korea
impacts.why: A steady policy rate maintains current borrowing costs while the hawkish bias preserves expectations of future tightening.
